name: Sales
description: Drives revenue growth by building strong customer relationships and effectively communicating product value

roles.name: Sales Manager
roles.description: Leads sales team to achieve revenue targets and build strong customer relationships
responsibilities: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet revenue targets
Manage sales team performance and development
Build and maintain key customer relationships
Coordinate with marketing and product teams on sales support

roles.name: Account Executive
roles.description: Manages customer accounts and drives revenue growth through relationship building
responsibilities: Identify and qualify sales opportunities and prospects
Understand customer needs and provide personalized solutions
Close deals and manage sales pipeline effectively
Maintain ongoing customer relationships and account management

roles.name: Sales Operations Specialist
roles.description: Optimizes sales processes, tools, and systems to improve sales performance
responsibilities: Manage sales processes, tools, and systems
Track sales performance and pipeline metrics
Develop sales training and enablement programs
Analyze sales data to identify optimization opportunities

plan.prompt: Develop a comprehensive sales strategy to achieve revenue targets and market expansion goals.
Create customer engagement and relationship building strategies based on the sales strategy.
Design sales processes and systems to support the sales strategy execution.
Finalize the integrated sales strategy with performance metrics and success criteria.
